You must execute below tasks in order:

1. Find out the root cause(s) of the unit test case issues
2. Create a branch
   - Branch naming convention should follow
     unit-tests/<source-branch-name>-<short-commit-hash>
   - determine the base branch from this {ref}
3. Generate unit test case updates
   - Only generate for these failed files
   - Use the commit context provided below
   - make sure to write test cases for all functions
4. Commit the generated test files to this new branch
   - commit the updated test cases
5. Create pull request with proper details
   - The pull request title should follow the naming convention:
     - Title: "AUTO-UNIT-TESTS-Add unit tests for <source-branch-name> changes"

MUST FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS:
- Must commit all changes to the branch before raising a PR request
- Ensure the generated tests follow best practices for maintainability and readability.
- Aim for meaningful coverage of all logic and edge cases introduced in the code changes.
